description: Greenhouse Job Board provides public, unauthenticated GET endpoints for job-board data, including jobs, offices, departments, and application fields. It also provides a POST endpoint for submitting applications, which requires HTTP Basic Authentication using a Job Board API key.
resolution_notes: auth_type: Set to other because authentication is mixed: GET endpoints require none, while application-submission POST requests require HTTP Basic Auth with a Job Board API key. Evidence: https://developers.greenhouse.io/job-board.html. description: Corrected because the API is not wholly read-only or unauthenticated; Greenhouse confirms that it exports public job data and imports applications through an authenticated POST endpoint. Evidence: https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/10568627186203-Greenhouse-API-overview
